name: NUE / X Steel Pairs Trade
description: Pairs trading strategy for Nucor (NUE) vs US Steel (X). Computes the NUE–X price spread, then z-scores it over a 60-day rolling window. When the z-score drops below –2 (spread compressed), go long NUE and short X expecting mean reversion. Exit when z-score crosses back above 0. Equal 50% allocation per leg.
source:
# NUE / X Steel Pairs Trading Strategy
# Spread: NUE close - X close
# Z-score: 60-day rolling window
# Entry: z < -2  (spread compressed → long NUE, short X)
# Exit:  z crosses above 0 (mean reversion achieved)
# Sizing: 50% per leg (equal dollar)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()

# Load reference prices for both legs (identical on every asset)
nue_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="NUE")()
x_ref   = reference_stocks(ticker="X")()

nue_close = nue_ref.c
x_close   = x_ref.c

# --- Spread & Z-Score ---
spread = nue_close - x_close
z = zscore(window=60)(spread)

# --- Entry / Exit Signals ---
# Entry pulse: z drops below -2
entry_pulse = z < -2

# Exit pulse: z crosses back above 0
exit_pulse = crossover(z, 0)

# Hold state from entry to exit (persist across bars)
pair_active = hold_until()(enter=entry_pulse, exit=exit_pulse)

# --- Asset Routing ---
# Route long signal to NUE, short signal to X
is_nue = is_asset_ref(ticker="NUE")()
is_x   = is_asset_ref(ticker="X")()

long_entry  = pair_active and is_nue   # Long NUE when pair is active
short_entry = pair_active and is_x     # Short X when pair is active

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
